mapper.sql: a.*, e.emp_no, e.name AS employee_name, e.user_id AS employee_user_id, d.name AS dept_name, u.nickname AS reviewer_name, p.name AS plan_name, p.status AS plan_status
FROM hr_perf_appraisal a JOIN hr_perf_plan p ON p.id = a.plan_id JOIN hr_employee e ON e.id = a.employee_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = a.dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.reviewer_id
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO hr_perf_appraisal (plan_id, employee_id, dept_id, reviewer_id, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{i.planId}, #{i.employeeId}, #{i.deptId}, #{i.reviewerId}, #{i.status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT a.employee_id, a.grade FROM hr_perf_appraisal a JOIN hr_perf_plan p ON p.id = a.plan_id WHERE p.pay_period = #{period} AND p.status = 'FINISHED' AND a.status = 'DONE' ORDER BY p.end_date
SELECT grade AS "grade", COUNT(*) AS "count", AVG(score) AS "avgScore" FROM hr_perf_appraisal WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND status = 'DONE' GROUP BY grade
